parameters.description: Step statuses to keep, e.g. `status=failed&status=aborted_with_custom_timeout` (a comma-separated list also works). Only steps with one of these statuses are returned, and workflows without any are left out. Failed and aborted steps carry their failure reason in `errors`.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Only return the runs of this step (for example `xcode-test`). A step used several times in a build is returned once per run, each with its own `uuid`.
parameters.name: step_id
